svg.text: EXPLODED VIEW — ten substrate cylinders between the JS adapter manifold (benchmarks) and the Python provider manifold (testbed)
MANIFOLD A — IdentityAdapter (JS): one declared operation catalogue; a substrate without a primitive throws NotSupported, never emulates
deploy createIdentity createIdentityWithAttributes resolveOwner resolveByVin resolveDocument verifyDelegate rotateController addDelegate setAttribute
transferVehicle metaTxSetAttribute revokeDelegate rotateDelegate revokeAttribute deactivate prepareIssuer anchorIssuerKey anchorStatus
MANIFOLD B — IdentityProvider (Python): PKI, centralized, ERC-1056, MOBI VID providers behind one interface (cv2x-testbed/identity/base.py)
register_vehicle sign_message verify_message revoke_credential check_revocation_status update_credential get_credential resolve_identity
providers attach to the cylinders they drive: ERC-1056 (vehicle profile) and MOBI VID V2; PKI and centralized are in-process baselines, not cylinders
LEGEND create/deploy/update/revoke = exact receipt gas, M1 (register #25; 30/30 runs byte-identical) harness = strict revert cells, register #28
frontier (register #36, harness run of record): C = on the cost-only frontier · R = cost + read path · 6 = all six criteria. CVIN-Combined carries no mark: dominated by ERC-4337 on all six.
create-identity spread on this table: 52,216 (CVIN-Combined) to 1,757,881 (ERC-735) = 33.67x
